# CG Academy — LLM Context File

> CG Academy is Common Ground's 90-Day AI Mastery program — a 12-week, self-paced curriculum that takes someone from "what the hell is an LLM" to a certified, automation-building AI practitioner. No degree required. Built around 8+ free certifications and roughly $150 in total out-of-pocket investment.

## Key Facts

- Name: CG Academy
- Parent: Common Ground (commonground.ventures)
- Program: 90-Day AI Mastery Plan
- Duration: 12 weeks, self-paced
- Cost: ~$150 total investment
- Certifications: 8+ free industry certifications included
- Target: 90th-percentile proficiency for complete beginners
- Website: https://cg-academy.vercel.app
- Curator: Brandon Ronning (Common Ground)

## What Students Get

- Structured 12-week curriculum organized in phases
- Dashboard for tracking progress through lessons and quizzes
- Full curriculum view with every module mapped out
- Lesson content with embedded quizzes
- Path to 8+ free certifications from major AI / cloud providers
- Graduation as a certified, automation-building AI practitioner

## Positioning

CG Academy exists because most "AI upskilling" programs are either free and shapeless or paid and bloated. The 90-Day plan is an opinionated path: what to learn, in what order, which certifications to stack, and how to actually ship automations by the end. Built for operators, career-switchers, and small-business teams — not PhDs.

## About Common Ground

Common Ground is the brand / capital / execution firm behind CG Academy. Common Ground works with pre-enterprise operators ($10–100M revenue) on brand architecture, revenue engineering, capital strategy, development, technology, and media. CG Academy is the education arm — how Common Ground trains the next generation of AI-literate operators.

- Parent site: https://commonground.ventures
